failureAnalysis.sourceFinding: The A3.1/A3.2 Lake Pump Room footprint is visibly larger than the sealed 29 feet 5 inches by 14 feet rectangle; the candidate dimensions were cross-registered from another feature.
failureAnalysis.roofFinding: A5.1/M2.0 show the Lake Pump Room under the larger sloped roof regime rather than the quarter-inch-per-foot plane used by the candidate.
failureAnalysis.sectionFinding: The candidate bound the Roof 1 purlin datum to the Lake Pump Room even though A8.1 identifies the Lake Pump Room with the Roof 3 section.
failureAnalysis.policyFinding: Placement must fail closed until one feature identity binds the plan boundary, roof slope, RCP regime, section datum, and PDF-to-local transform.
